settings.verse: They shall call his name Emmanuel, which being interpreted is, God with us.
settings.story: Matthew tells the birth of Jesus Christ, from Joseph learning of Mary’s pregnancy to the arrival of the wise men. Jesus is introduced as Immanuel, God with us: the Savior arriving and the beginning of His earthly life.
settings.note: This piece represents the arrival of the Savior and the beginning of the earthly life of Jesus. Inspired by Matthew 1:18–25 and 2:1–12.
settings.no_piece_text: No piece here. Just the cross.

settings.verse: It is written, Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word that proceedeth out of the mouth of God.
settings.story: After fasting forty days and nights, Jesus is tempted by Satan. Each time, He answers with Scripture, beginning with the words “It is written.” The power of knowing God’s Word and standing on it when temptation comes.
settings.note: This piece represents the power of knowing God’s Word and standing on Scripture when temptation comes. Inspired by Matthew 4:1–11, especially 4:4.
settings.no_piece_text: No piece here. Just the cross.

settings.verse: But when he saw the wind boisterous, he was afraid; and beginning to sink, he cried, saying, Lord, save me.
settings.story: Peter steps out of the boat and walks toward Jesus on the water. When fear of the wind and waves takes over, he begins to sink and cries out. Jesus immediately reaches out His hand and saves him. Even when faith is shaken, we can still call on Jesus.
settings.note: A reminder that even when our faith becomes shaken and fear takes over, we can still call on Jesus. Inspired by Matthew 14:30.
settings.no_piece_text: No piece here. Just the cross.

settings.verse: Eli, Eli, lama sabachthani? that is to say, My God, my God, why hast thou forsaken me?
settings.story: Jesus is crucified outside Jerusalem. Darkness covers the land, and He gives up His life for the sins of the world.
settings.no_piece_text: No piece here. Just the cross.

settings.verse: He is not here: for he is risen, as he said.
settings.story: Mary Magdalene and the other Mary come to the tomb and find it empty. An angel tells them Jesus has risen, just as He said He would. The resurrection: the empty tomb and the victory over death.
settings.piece_name: He Is Not Here / He Has Risen
settings.note: This piece represents the resurrection of Jesus Christ: the empty tomb and the victory over death. Inspired by Matthew 28:1–10.
settings.no_piece_text: No piece here. Just the cross.

settings.verse: Go ye therefore, and teach all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Ghost.
settings.story: After His resurrection, Jesus meets His disciples and gives the Great Commission. They are called to baptize, teach, and carry His message into the world. Take what you have learned from Scripture and share it.
settings.note: This piece represents the mission to take what we’ve learned from Scripture and share it with others. Inspired by Matthew 28:16–20.
settings.no_piece_text: No piece here. Just the cross.

settings.gate_sub: Every drop is a book of the Bible.
settings.shop_sub: Five pieces. Five moments. One story.
